body.condition: Every variable assigned by an activation predicate in \(\mathcal C\) belongs to \(V\), whether or not it is a root in \(G\).

novel.justification: The regime covers measured states that switch mechanisms after observed history, such as adherence after prior symptoms, a triage decision after recorded covariates, or a device mode selected from measured telemetry. These endogenous but observed switches fall outside control-variable results that require each switch to be a root.
